content.title: When is the USA-Venezuela World Baseball Classic final? Here's how to watch
content.text: Team USA now knows its opponent for the 2026 World Baseball Classic final. The Americans took down high-flying Dominican Republic 2-1 in their semifinal matchup on Sunday, one day before the second semifinal. Venezuela on Monday rallied late to beat Italy 4-2. A three-run seventh inning gave the Venezuelans the edge they were hunting, and the Italians couldn't add to their score after putting up both runs in the second. Italy had been the only team to get the better of the U.S. so far in this tournament, which came in the Americans' Pool B finale in a 8-6 late-rally loss. The final will mark the first matchup between the U.S. and Venezuela in this tournament. Led by Ronald Acuna Jr., Luis Arraez, Eugenio Suarez and Wilyer Abreu, among others, the Venezuelans are hoping to upset the U.S. for their first ever WBC triumph. After eliminating Shohei Ohtani and Japan, their momentum is soaring, while the U.S. is aiming to avenge its 2023 final loss. Here's everything to know to catch the action, where a trophy and bragging rights are on the line: MORE WORLD BASEBALL CLASSIC COVERAGE When is the 2026 World Baseball Classic final? The final is set for Tuesday, March 17. What time is the 2026 World Baseball Classic final? First pitch is set for 8 p.m. ET/5 p.m. PT. Where is the 2026 World Baseball Classic final? LoanDepot Park, home of the Miami Marlins, is the venue for the action. Who is playing in the 2026 World Baseball Classic final? Team USA will take on Venezuela, their first such matchup in this tournament. Venezuela went 3-1 in Pool D to finish second, just like the U.S. in Pool B. The Dominican Republic topped that group at 4-0 before falling to the U.S. in the semifinals, just like previously-unbeaten Pool B leaders Italy to Venezuela. Where to watch the 2026 World Baseball Classic final on TV, online The game will be broadcast on FOX. Streaming will be available via the Fox Sports mobile app, FoxSports.com and Tubi. 1:21Everything you need to know about the 2026 World Baseball Classic A preview of the 2026 World Baseball Classic, including key dates, format, host cities, and the biggest storylines as the world’s best players compete in baseball’s biggest international tournament.
